# Privacy

- Cartwheel shipment data carries consignee PII (names, street addresses, phone numbers). Logs
  and payloads I paste may include it. Strip it before quoting anything back to me, and never put
  it in a PR, an issue, a commit message or a web request.
- Anything under `~/Notes/Garden/Health/` or `~/Documents/Finance/` stays on this machine.
- feedsmith is public. Before suggesting a commit there, check the diff for internal hostnames
  (`*.cartwheel.internal`) and for my home server's Tailscale name.
